definition: LocallyGrounded A a d says that at every world accessible from a some fact is admitted as a reason for d there. The reason may differ from world to world, so this is the world-local truthmaker or reason of whichever disjunct holds there.
note: Analyst-stated condition for #485; it is under test, not asserted. A sourced reading would need pinned witnesses for the grounding-of-disjunction literature listed on #485 (Merlo 2020, Trogdon 2013, Leuenberger 2014), none of which was read for this work.
